description: This file implements a React component for a file upload field, including UI controls for uploading, displaying file details, and managing file states within a form. It handles displaying icons based on file types, formatting file sizes, and managing file data and validation.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Formats a byte size into human-readable string with appropriate units.

methods.name: useFileData
methods.description: Retrieves metadata and icon for a given file value, including handling object URLs for uploaded files.

methods.name: getFileIcon
methods.description: Determines the icon to display based on the file extension.

methods.name: getExtension
methods.description: Extracts the file extension from a filename.

methods.name: useTrimStartStyles
methods.description: Provides CSS styles for truncating text with ellipsis in RTL or LTR layouts.

methods.name: createErrorMessage
methods.description: Generates an error message based on the file value validity.

methods.name: validateFile
methods.description: Validates a file's validity state, returning an error message if invalid.
